# Git Badges Playground

> Interactive GitHub achievements playground and GitHub badges tutorial for Pull Shark, YOLO, Quickdraw, Pair Extraordinaire, Starstruck, and Galaxy Brain.

Git Badges Playground is a public repository that teaches GitHub profile achievements through a local interactive sandbox. It includes a TypeScript playground, plus PowerShell and Bash fallbacks, that use GitHub CLI to create real branches, commits, pull requests, issues, merges, and co-authored commits in a repository controlled by the user.

## Canonical URLs

- GitHub repository: https://github.com/HIDORAKAI002/git-badges
- GitHub Pages site: https://hidorakai002.github.io/git-badges/

- GitHub achievements mirror: https://hidorakai002.github.io/git-badges/docs/github-achievements.md

## Key Files

- README.md: Main tutorial and fast start.
- docs/github-badges.html: Designed HTML guide for readers.
- scripts/unlock.ts: TypeScript interactive achievement playground. Run with `npm start` or `node scripts/unlock.ts`.
- scripts/unlock.ps1: Windows PowerShell fallback playground.
- scripts/unlock.sh: Bash fallback playground.
- docs/github-badges.md: Search-friendly markdown mirror for GitHub badges.
- docs/github-achievements.md: Search-friendly markdown mirror for GitHub achievements.
- docs/starstruck.md: Starstruck strategy guide.
- docs/galaxy-brain.md: Galaxy Brain strategy guide.
- docs/troubleshooting.md: Badge troubleshooting notes.

## Responsible Use

The project helps users practice legitimate GitHub workflows in repositories they own or control. It should not be used to spam maintainers, create low-quality pull requests in other projects, buy stars, or flood GitHub Discussions.
